entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I'd like to start a return for an order I received last week.
I can certainly help with that. Do you have your order number handy?

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Velo-Pro Helmet in 'Electric Blue'. It looks like it was delivered 8 days ago. To make sure I'm helping correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's just a preference thing. The online picture made the color look a bit brighter than it is in person. The box is still unopened, I haven't even taken it out.
I understand completely; screen settings can sometimes alter how a color appears. Just to be absolutely certain, there are no concerns with the fit or any of the safety features, correct?
No, nothing like that. It's purely about the color.

Not a problem at all. Our standard apparel and gear, like this helmet, come with a 90-day return policy. Since you're only on day 8, you are well within the window for a full refund. I can get that process started for you right now.

That's great to hear. Now, since I have to go through the process of sending it back and re-ordering a different one, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase? Just to offset the inconvenience.

I appreciate you asking, and I understand the logic. However, our policy doesn't allow for goodwill credits or discounts for returns based on a preference like color. What I can do is ensure you get a full refund for the helmet itself, and I'll email you a pre-paid return shipping label so it costs you nothing to send it back.
Okay, I see. So there's no way to even get a small store credit, say $10, instead of a discount code? It would make me feel better about placing another order right away.

I am sorry, but my system is strict on that rule to keep things fair for everyone. The best I can offer, per VeloFit policy, is the full, no-questions-asked refund and the free return shipping label. Once we receive the item, the funds will be back in your account within 3-5 business days.
Alright, that's fair enough. A full refund with free shipping is a good solution. I accept. Thank you for clarifying.
You're very welcome. I've just sent that email with the label to the address on file. You should see it in your inbox shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Sarah.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
